description: Talsperre im Saarland is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. dams of the Saarland; Data includes the following objects as dams: Nonnweiler dam, Losheimer reservoir, Bostalsee and others. Viewing object in the GDZ MultiFeature class, consists of the punctual feature class GDZ2010.Pwltalsp and the associated business table with the factual data (GDZ2010.wltalösp). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Dams in Saarland" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Saarland, WASSER_Talsperren, Ver- und Entsorgung/Nachrichtenwesen. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
